title: Walking suit of enchanted armour
placement: 64 x 64 frames. Bottom-centre origin (32, 64). Manual rectangular collision mask, fixed across all frames. Ground contact is the lower frame edge; do not auto-trim or independently centre frames. PNG files do not store origin, speed or collision settings.
